Everything a subscription can do to you, SubSafe does something about.

Four parts, one job: make sure you always know what you're paying for, and always have a way out.

Dashboard

Every subscription, one screen.

See what's active, what's due next, and your total monthly and yearly spend — without opening a single billing page or bank statement.

Renewal alerts

A real warning, not a 24-hour scramble.

Most apps tell you a day before you're charged — after you've basically already decided to keep paying. Set your own lead time when you add a subscription, so you actually have time to think it over.

1-tap cancellation

The cancel link is already there.
